description: This file contains test scripts for the admin controller of a web application, utilizing the Test2 framework and the Test::Coocook module to perform HTTP request tests and login validation.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Test::Coocook testing object.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Clones the current test object to create an anonymous user agent.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and checks for success.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs login with provided credentials and verifies success.

methods.name: base_like
methods.description: Checks if the base URL matches a given regex pattern.
